results.requirement_text: The NASA Project Manager shall develop, maintain, and execute a Software Development Plan and a Software Security Plan covering the full software life cycle from requirements through retirement, addressing every applicable requirement of NPR 7150.2D per the approved Requirements Mapping Matrix.

audit.reasoning: SWE-013 mandates development and execution of software plans covering the full life cycle and addressing NPR 7150.2D requirements with approved tailoring. SWE-125 requires a requirements mapping matrix to align with NPR requirements. The proposed requirement satisfies both by explicitly stating development, maintenance, execution of software and security plans, and reference to the approved mapping matrix.

citations.quote: 3.1.3 The project manager shall develop, maintain, and execute software plans, including security plans, that cover the entire software life cycle and, as a minimum, address the requirements of this directive with approved tailoring. [SWE-013]

Each project manager with software components shall maintain a requirements mapping matrix or multiple requirements mapping matrices against requirements in this NPR, including those delegated to other parties or accomplished by contract vehicles or Space Act Agreements.

retrieved.requirement_text: 3.1.3 The project manager shall develop, maintain, and execute software plans, including security plans, that cover the entire software life cycle and, as a minimum, address the requirements of this directive with approved tailoring. [SWE-013]

Each project manager with software components shall maintain a requirements mapping matrix or multiple requirements mapping matrices against requirements in this NPR, including those delegated to other parties or accomplished by contract vehicles or Space Act Agreements.

4.1.2 The project manager shall establish, capture, record, approve, and maintain software requirements, including requirements for COTS, GOTS, MOTS, OSS, or reused software components, as part of the technical specification. [SWE-050]

The project manager shall perform software requirements analysis based on flowed-down and derived requirements from the top-level systems engineering requirements, safety and reliability analyses, and the hardware specifications and design.
The project manager shall plan and implement software operations, maintenance, and retirement activities.
The project manager shall plan and implement software assurance, software safety, and IV&V (if required) per NASA-STD-8739.8, Software Assurance and Software Safety Standard.
The project manager shall include software related safety constraints, controls, mitigations, and assumptions between the hardware, operator, and software in the software requirements documentation.
4.1.5 The project manager shall track and manage changes to the software requirements. [SWE-053]

The project manager shall develop, record, and maintain a software design based on the software architectural design that describes the lower-level units so that they can be coded, compiled, and tested.
4.5.7 The project manager shall update the software test and verification plan(s) and procedure(s) to be consistent with software requirements. [SWE-071]

results.requirement_text: The NASA software shall meet performance expectations as determined by the development team prior to delivery.

audit.reasoning: The proposed requirement states performance expectations are determined by the development team, but NASA requires the project manager to monitor and ensure performance meets or exceeds requirements, including constraints. The requirement lacks accountability to the project manager and omits verification against defined performance and functionality requirements. SWE-199 and SWE-055 mandate performance validation and monitoring, which are not addressed.

citations.quote: The project manager shall monitor measures to ensure the software will meet or exceed performance and functionality requirements, including satisfying constraints.
4.1.7 The project manager shall perform requirements validation to ensure that the software will perform as intended in the customer environment. [SWE-055]

retrieved.requirement_text: The project manager shall monitor measures to ensure the software will meet or exceed performance and functionality requirements, including satisfying constraints.
The project manager shall track the actual results and performance of software activities against the software plans.
3.1.5 The project manager shall define and document the acceptance criteria for the software. [SWE-034]

3.2.3 The project manager shall submit software planning parameters, including size and effort estimates, milestones, and characteristics, to the Center measurement repository at the conclusion of major milestones. [SWE-174]
4.5.3 The project manager shall test the software against its requirements. [SWE-066]

The project manager shall complete, prior to delivery, verification that all software requirements identified for this delivery have been met or dispositioned, that all approved changes have been implemented, and that all defects designated for resolution prior to delivery have been resolved.
4.1.7 The project manager shall perform requirements validation to ensure that the software will perform as intended in the customer environment. [SWE-055]
5.4.6 The project manager shall collect, track, and report software requirements volatility metrics. [SWE-200]
3.1.7 The project manager shall define and document the milestones at which the software developer(s) progress will be reviewed and audited. [SWE-037]
The project manager shall assess options for software acquisition versus development.

results.requirement_text: Changes to NASA software requirements shall be logged in the issue tracker by the engineer making the change.

audit.reasoning: NASA SWE-053 mandates the project manager to track and manage changes, not the engineer. The proposed requirement shifts responsibility to the engineer, which contradicts the obligation.
